title: Butter & Scotch Bakery and Craft Bar
ldIngredientsRaw: Whipped cream & a Luxardo cherry for garnish
ldInstructionsRaw: In a blender, combine the rock & rye, cherry purée, and ice cream, and blend until smooth. Pour into a parfait or pint glass, top with whipped cream and a cherry, and serve with a straw and a spoon.
